path.description: Source data file (.csv, .json, .xlsx, .xls). It is not changed.

columns.description: Exact names of the columns to replace with pseudonyms (for example the columns holding names, emails or phone numbers).

outputPath.description: Optional. Where to write the pseudonymized copy; by default <name>.pseudonymized.<ext> beside the source. Must not already exist. The key file is written beside it as <copy name>.key.csv.
